full_raw_preservation: All 32 PNG and four NPZ/bundle batches per condition retained unchanged on server and verified local export.
GitHub_showcase_rule: For each condition show fixed cohort index0 plus the least-mean-cosine sample on each separately analyzed path; deduplicate identical PNG identity.
review_ZIP_PNG_rule: For each condition include cohort index0 and all least-similar-three samples per path under unchanged existing mean-cosine rule; deduplicate only identical file identities.
review_ZIP_raw_matrix_rule: Include all 24 original NPZ, corresponding records, masks, permutations, beam paths, plot receipts and every image identity even when PNG omitted.
statistics_selection_rule: Inherit existing attention_statistics.py least_similar_three_under_declared_mean_cosine; no new threshold and no unsupported-case removal.
paired_prediction_example_rule: Per comparison, first three users by descending changed original candidate positions, then largest Top10 set difference, then sample_key ascending; also first3 gained/lost @10 in sorted keys.
scientific_scope: Single seed42; within-route Normal comparison; row-pair descriptions within each raw condition/path, no nonaligned cross-Shuffle column comparison.
